topic: The one line every website needs: city + service in the page title
caption:
Most business websites waste their page title.
It says 'Home' or the business name and nothing else.
Add your service and your city to that title tag and Google finally knows who to show you to.
'Plumber in Hesperia' is a full sentence to a search engine.
DM us 'TITLE' and we'll check yours for free.
